title: Urban-Rural Disparities in Returns to Education and Income Inequality in China: Evidence from CHIP 2018

contributions.purpose: 用最新 CHIP 2018 数据更新中国教育回报率估计
contributions.mechanism: 标准 Mincer 方程 OLS(教育年限+经验+经验平方,扩展模型加性别/城乡),N=27,920
contributions.domain: 劳动经济学 / 教育经济学(中国)
contributions.source_quote: The analysis reveals that the overall return to education is 6.52% (SE=0.18%, p<0.001)

contributions.purpose: 揭示教育回报的城乡异质性
contributions.mechanism: 教育x城乡交互项模型(Education x Urban)
contributions.evaluation: 城市回报 7.41% 比农村 4.75% 高 56%;交互系数 0.0266(SE=0.0041, p<0.001);加入交互后 Urban 主效应转为 -0.1012(不显著)
contributions.source_quote: urban returns (7.41%) exceed rural returns (4.75%) by 56%, a difference that is both statistically significant (p<0.001) and economically substantial.

contributions.purpose: 检验教育对收入不平等是均等化还是放大作用
contributions.evaluation: 回报率沿收入分布单调递增:P10 为 4.21% → P90 为 8.09%(均 p<0.001),表明教育扩张在现有条件下放大而非缓解不平等
contributions.source_quote: returns increase monotonically across the income distribution, from 4.21% at the 10th percentile to 8.09% at the 90th percentile, suggesting education amplifies rather than mitigates inequality.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Using the latest available data from CHIP 2018, this study provides updated estimates of education returns employing standard Mincer equation methodology.

notes: reject。三条贡献均为 finding,无方法创新(标准 Mincer OLS+分位数回归,未处理内生性,作者在 checklist 中自认 inability to fully address endogeneity)。核心结论本身是政策负面发现:教育放大不平等(P10 4.21% vs P90 8.09%)。数据质量自曝:样本保留率仅 39.2%(71,266→27,920),正收入报告率 72.6%,abstract 明言其影响估计。疑点:checklist 声称 Section 5.3 讨论 limitations,但正文 Discussion 只有 5.1/5.2,不存在 5.3;abstract 数字(4.2%/8.1%)与正文(4.21%/8.09%)舍入不一致;正文引 Table 2 的月工作时长(10.89 vs 9.94)未出现在表中。数据不开放(CHIP 需机构授权,checklist 该项答 No),仅附处理代码片段。AI 参与 checklist:假设/实验设计/分析/写作四项全为 D(AI-generated),自称 AI 完成 95% 以上研究;自报 AI 局限:缺乏新理论框架构建与需领域知识的复杂经济关系解释能力。
